categories_checked.note: No national grant/loan scheme found on the pages read: need-based DSU grants are run regionally (see 'regional'). Bank loans exist via universities (e.g. Bocconi student loans), not recorded. Search was limited (web search budget exhausted).
ER.GO and DiSCo housing places; Unibo rent contribution (2025/26). Padova 'sostegno canone locazione' and DiSCo 'contributi alloggio' links seen but not opened.
No subsidy found: voluntary SSN costs at least €700/year; SSN is mandatory and free only if you work and pay taxes in Italy (see bureaucracy).
ATM Milano under-27/under-30, GTT Torino under-26 ISEE rates. Bologna (Unibo/TPER reduced fare) amount not found; Rome and Padua not found.
Not researched (web search budget exhausted). Candidate to verify: rent deduction for off-site students on the Agenzia delle Entrate site.
Incoming: EDISU Piemonte reduced canteen rate; DiSCo allows combining Erasmus grants with DSU. Outgoing top-ups: ER.GO and Polimi DSU mobility contributions.
DSU scholarships: ER.GO (Emilia-Romagna), DSU Polimi (Lombardy), DiSCo (Lazio), University of Padua regional scholarship (Veneto; ESU Padova runs housing/meals), EDISU Piemonte.
Bocconi need-based tuition waivers, Polimi merit scholarships, PoliTO TOPoliTO, Padua international scholarships. Sapienza scholarship page not found.

items.authority: ER.GO - Azienda Regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori (Emilia-Romagna)
items.description: Need- and merit-based regional scholarship for students at universities in Emilia-Romagna (incl. University of Bologna). Includes full tuition exemption and refund of the regional tax; amount depends on ISEE and on being resident (in sede), commuter or off-site (non-resident with documented domicile). Part can be converted into meal vouchers.

eligibility.income_test: ISEE below €25,000 and ISPE below €50,000 (a.y. 2026/27); both must be within the limits
other: Families with income/assets abroad must upload documents issued in the year of application, legalised/apostilled and translated into Italian

items.how_to_apply: Online application each year by the call deadlines (tassative); foreign-income documents uploaded in the ER.GO Dossier Utente.
items.deadline: 2026/27 call closed; the site shows 'Scaduto il 24/08/2026 16:00' (step not specified)
items.notes: Euro amounts are only in the 2026/27 bando PDF, which could not be read. Whether exchange students are excluded is not stated on the pages read (marked degree only as an assumption from the call structure).

items.name_local: Borsa di studio DSU - Politecnico di Milano
items.name_it: Borsa di studio per il diritto allo studio (Politecnico di Milano)
items.authority: Politecnico di Milano - Servizio Diritto allo Studio (regional DSU, Lombardy)
items.description: Need-based scholarship for Polimi students, paid partly in cash and partly in services (mainly meals); amount differs for local, commuter and off-site students. Off-site students can also apply for subsidised housing in Polimi residences.

eligibility.income_test: ISEE for university benefits not above the call limit; Polimi's fee page gives €26,887.93 as the scholarship-access threshold (2026/27)
other: Continuing students need minimum credits; first-years must reach minimum credits during the year

items.how_to_apply: Apply online by the deadlines in the yearly Bando (published every June), even before enrolling or taking the admission test.
items.deadline: See 'Principali scadenze DSU 2026-2027' PDF on the Polimi page
items.notes: ISEE parificato rules for international students not stated on the pages read. Bocconi students apply through ISU Bocconi instead (see Bocconi record).

items.name_it: Borsa di studio DiSCo Lazio (Roma, incl. Sapienza)
items.authority: DiSCo - Ente regionale per il Diritto allo Studio e la promozione della Conoscenza (Lazio)
items.description: Regional scholarship for students enrolled at universities headquartered in Lazio (incl. Sapienza). 2026/27 base amounts: off-site €6,571.11, commuter €3,590.71, in-town €2,290.16, each plus 2 free daily meals (worth €600). Full amount up to 2/3 of the ISEE threshold, reduced to half from ISEE €18,893.25; +20% for women in STEM.

eligibility.income_test: ISEE/ISEEUP up to €28,339.88 and ISPE/ISPEUP up to €61,608.48
other: Enrolled by 10 Feb 2027 in a bachelor, master, single-cycle, PhD or specialisation course at a Lazio university
Students with family not resident in Italy must file the ISEE Universitario Parificato (ISEEUP) at a DiSCo-approved CAF with documents from the Italian diplomatic authorities, translated into Italian
Excluded if you already hold a degree of the same level (also obtained abroad)

items.how_to_apply: Online application in the DiSCo reserved area; non-resident families: ISEEUP at a recognised CAF (free assistance).
items.deadline: Applications 10 June-22 July 2026 12:00; ISEEUP by 10 December 2026 (a.y. 2026/27)
items.stackable: The call lists Erasmus grants among grants that can be combined.

interpretations.hypothesis: +15% increase applies with ISEE up to €13,974.30 (Art. 8 text)
+15% (115%) amounts apply with ISEE up to €14,169.94 (Table 6 of the same call)

items.notes: The English call heads the thresholds table 'For academic year 2025/2026', likely a carry-over; the Italian call is the legal text. The 2026/27 call is now open only for the graduation award.

items.name_local: Borsa di studio regionale - Università di Padova
items.name_it: Borsa di studio regionale (Veneto) - Università di Padova
items.authority: Università di Padova - Ufficio Servizi agli studenti, Benefici economici (Regione Veneto)
items.description: Regional scholarship for low-income Italian and foreign students at the University of Padua (bachelor, master, single-cycle, PhD without other grant). ESU Padova provides student housing and meals.

other: ISEE parificato required for international students (EU and non-EU) with family abroad, and for those resident in Italy earning under €9,000 from work with family abroad; only via the CAF that has an agreement with the University
Excluded if you already hold a degree of equal or higher level

items.how_to_apply: By the deadline: submit the 'Richiesta di agevolazioni' in Uniweb, request the ISEE/ISEE parificato for university benefits, and pay the first fee instalment. Missing any step means exclusion.
items.notes: Amounts are in the Bando Borse Studio 2026-27 PDF (not read).

items.description: Regional scholarship for students at Piedmont universities (incl. Politecnico di Torino), based on the ISEE Universitario and merit; off-site students can request a residence place with the same application.

eligibility.income_test: ISEE Universitario within the call thresholds (values not shown on the page)
other: First-years need at least 20 credits by the call deadlines
International students without Italian residence/SPID can request a temporary access code (valid until 30 June)

items.how_to_apply: Online via the EDISU Sportello (SPID/CIE or temporary code); check rankings in your personal area.
items.deadline: Bachelor/master: 22 July-4 September 2026 12:00; PhD/specialisation: 28 October-27 November 2026 12:00 (a.y. 2026/27)
items.notes: Amounts and ISEE thresholds are in the bando PDF / Guida ISEE 2026/27 (not read).

items.description: Subsidised place in ER.GO residences for eligible students at Emilia-Romagna universities, awarded through the same DSU call.
items.how_to_apply: Through the yearly ER.GO DSU call.

items.description: Residence places for scholarship-eligible students at Lazio universities. Of first-year places, at least 20% are guaranteed to non-EU international students and at least 5% to stateless students and recognised refugees. A separate 'subsidised accommodation place' has a higher ISEE limit.

eligibility.income_test: Accommodation place: ISEE/ISEEUP up to €28,339.88 and ISPE/ISPEUP up to €61,608.48; subsidised accommodation place: ISEE/ISEEUP up to €86,956.58

items.name_it: Contributo per l'affitto per studenti fuori sede (Università di Bologna)
items.description: Partial rent reimbursements of €1,000 for off-site students, mentioned for 2025/26; a 2026/27 edition was not confirmed.

other: Off-site (fuori sede) students; other criteria not read

items.notes: Only a one-line mention on the housing page; conditions and current-year availability not verified.

items.description: Reduced urban passes in Milan: under 27 €22/month or €200/year instead of €39/€330, with no income limit; under 30 same rates with ISEE below €28,000.

eligibility.income_test: None under 27; ISEE below €28,000 for ages 27-29

items.how_to_apply: ATM app (digital card) or ATM Point; annual under-30 also via authorised CAF.

items.name_local: Abbonamento annuale GTT Under 26 a tariffa ISEE
items.name_it: Abbonamento annuale GTT Under 26 con tariffa ISEE (Torino)
items.description: Annual Under 26 pass at €158 (ISEE up to €12,000), €178 (up to €20,000) or €208 (up to €50,000) instead of €258.

eligibility.residence_requirement: Turin residence, or domicile with a registered lease in your name or in a recognised university residence

items.how_to_apply: GTT sales points / e-commerce with ISEE certificate.
items.notes: Regione Piemonte 'Piemove' bonus for university students under 26 is mentioned by GTT but its amount was not read.

items.name_local: Agevolazioni TPER e Start Romagna per studenti Unibo
items.name_it: Abbonamenti agevolati TPER / Start Romagna per studenti Unibo
items.description: University of Bologna students can buy bus passes in Bologna, Cesena, Forlì, Ravenna and Rimini at a reduced price.

other: Enrolled at the University of Bologna

items.notes: Price not shown on the overview page; dedicated page not opened. Whether exchange students qualify is not stated.

items.name_it: Attività di collaborazione degli studenti (150 ore) - Università di Bologna
items.description: Part-time on-campus collaborations of up to 150 hours (usually max 15 h/week), paid €8.50 per hour worked, up to €1,275 tax-free, as a lump sum at the end. 1,371 places in 2026/27.

eligibility.income_test: Income/merit requirements in each campus call; lower ISEE is a ranking criterion
other: Non-Italian citizens must present an A2 Italian certificate before starting (unless studying in Italian / Italian diploma)

items.name_it: Collaborazioni a tempo parziale 200 ore - Università di Padova
items.description: Part-time collaborations of up to 200 hours; not an employment relationship. Hourly pay not stated on the page.

eligibility.income_test: Economic and merit requirements (in the call)
other: First-year bachelor and single-cycle students and part-time students excluded; first-year master students may apply

items.stackable: Combinable with the regional scholarship and tutoring activities.

items.name_local: Ristorazione per studenti in mobilità internazionale in ingresso
items.name_it: Tariffa mensa agevolata per studenti Erasmus in arrivo (EDISU Piemonte)
items.description: Incoming Erasmus students at Piedmont universities get the reduced canteen rate (Fascia 1) until the end date reported by their host university. Erasmus grants themselves are paid by the home institution.

eligibility.stay_duration: Until the mobility end date communicated by the host university

items.amount: Fascia 1 canteen rate (price per meal not shown)
items.how_to_apply: No application: use the credentials EDISU emails after the host university sends your data; register the Campus Piemonte ID MEAL app.
items.notes: 'Erasmus grants are paid by the home institution' is the brief's general rule, not stated on this page.

items.name_local: Contributo per mobilità internazionale (ER.GO / DSU Polimi)
items.name_it: Integrazione DSU per la mobilità internazionale
items.description: For students enrolled in Italy (including international degree students) who go abroad: ER.GO grants an international mobility contribution, and Polimi pays a DSU top-up for mobility programmes of 2-10 months.

eligibility.income_test: ER.GO: ISEE below €25,000 and ISPE below €50,000 (a.y. 2026/27); Polimi: DSU eligibility

items.notes: Not available to incoming exchange students.

items.name_local: Bocconi Access to Education Scholarships / ISU Bocconi
items.name_it: Esoneri per merito e reddito Bocconi (Access to Education, Boost your Future) e borsa ISU Bocconi
items.description: For first-year bachelor/law students 2026/27: need-based tuition waivers of 100%, 80% or 60% (Access to Education) and 40% or 20% (Boost your Future), based on the family's economic and asset situation; also a Women Award and disability waivers regardless of income. Later years: ISU Bocconi scholarship and excellence awards (full tuition exemption).

eligibility.income_test: Family economic and asset situation (thresholds not shown)

items.how_to_apply: Via each scheme's page; status in the Myapplication portal.
items.notes: Whether all schemes are open to non-Italian students is not stated on the overview pages; Italian candidates are directed to a separate page.

items.name_local: Merit-based scholarships for international students (Politecnico di Milano)
items.name_it: Borse di merito per studenti internazionali (Politecnico di Milano)
items.description: For international applicants admitted to an English-taught Master of Science (a.y. 2027/28, first semester, Early bird applicants): full tuition waiver (only a ~€170 administrative fee); some awards add a gross allowance of up to €10,000/year. Selection on prior education, GPA and application form.

other: International applicants to English-taught MSc, Early bird period

items.amount: Full tuition waiver; some up to €10,000/year gross (a.y. 2027/28)
items.how_to_apply: Apply in the Early bird period and fill in the scholarship application form.
items.deadline: Application fee paid 1 October-1 December 2026; English certificate by 4 March 2027
items.notes: 'International' is defined in the call PDF (not read): whether EU citizens qualify should be checked there.

items.description: Scholarship of €8,000 gross per year to attract top international students to bachelor and master programmes; calls published in English on the programme page.
items.how_to_apply: Per the call on the TOPoliTO page.

items.name_local: Padua International Excellence Scholarship Programme / tuition waivers
items.name_it: Borse di eccellenza e esoneri per studenti internazionali (Università di Padova)
items.description: Scholarships for outstanding international students enrolling in English-taught bachelor or master degrees, plus 100 full tuition fee waivers for international students in English-taught programmes.
items.notes: Amounts and academic year not stated on the overview page.
